cat >> tests/test_statement.py <<'EOF'


def _rows(text):
    import csv
    import io

    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(text)))


def test_usd_payee_with_comma_matches_the_header():
    text = export_statement(
        [Line("chk-100", "2024-06-02", "Smith, Jones LLP", 1250, "retainer", "USD")]
    )
    header, row = _rows(text)
    assert len(row) == len(header)
    assert row == ["chk-100", "2024-06-02", "Smith, Jones LLP", "12.50", "retainer"]
    assert '"Smith, Jones LLP"' in text


def test_quotes_and_newlines_are_escaped():
    text = export_statement(
        [Line("chk-100", "2024-06-02", 'The "Best" Co', 100, "line1\nline2, x", "GBP")]
    )
    header, row = _rows(text)
    assert row == ["chk-100", "2024-06-02", 'The "Best" Co', "1.00", "line1\nline2, x"]
    assert '"The ""Best"" Co"' in text


def test_eur_comma_is_preserved_not_flattened():
    text = export_statement(
        [Line("eur-1", "2024-06-02", "Müller, Schmidt GmbH", 100, "a,b", "EUR")]
    )
    _, row = _rows(text)
    assert row == ["eur-1", "2024-06-02", "Müller, Schmidt GmbH", "1.00", "a,b"]
EOF
